summary: Mountain Lake Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands blank-check company, filed an 8-K on June 10, 2026, reporting the postponement of its extraordinary general meeting to June 16, 2026. Shareholders are to vote on extending the deadline to consummate an initial business combination from June 16, 2026 to September 16, 2026. The extension is needed to allow more time to close the previously approved business combination with Avalanche Treasury Corporation. No deal terms or advisor names were disclosed. Watch for shareholder approval of the extension and subsequent close of the business combination.
